title: Corniculate
summary: CORNICULATE, adjective [from Latin , a horn.] 1. Horned; having horns. 2. In botany, producing horned pods; bearing a little spur or horn.

inlines.v: CORNICULATE, adjective [from Latin , a horn.] 1. Horned; having horns. 2. In botany, producing horned pods; bearing a little spur or horn.
